title: Frontend: Sum of n natural numbers
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Sum of n natural numbers. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Implement solution(n). n is a nonnegative decimal integer string. Return exact 1+...+n as a decimal string. Reject malformed or negative input with Invalid n.
constraints: Define solution(input) in plain JavaScript. Return the documented JSON-compatible value or throw the documented validation error. Each case receives a fresh input.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Use n(n+1)/2 rather than a loop when only the total is required.
alternativeApproaches: Compute a closed integer range sum and avoid overflow-prone intermediate operations in fixed-width languages.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: n=0; n=1; ordinary n.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
